new_authoritative_findings: The PUBLISHED TPAMI 2022 version renumbers the references: 3DMM fitting is [61] (not arXiv's [60]) and face alignment remains [70]. [61] = Liu, Jourabloo, Ren, Liu, 'Dense face alignment', ICCVW 2017; [70] = Bulat & Tzimiropoulos, ICCV 2017. This CONFIRMS M6A2's upstream identification - the same two works - under the published numbering. No new source repository is introduced.

The published version STILL states 'Source code and pre-trained models will be publicly available upon publication.' No such release exists: the author's GitHub account has 7 public repositories and NONE is PhySTD/STDN+/PAMI-2022, and the official MSU CVLab project page - which lists BOTH the ECCV 2020 and the PAMI 2022 papers - offers exactly one code link for this lineage, https://github.com/yaojieliu/ECCV20-STDN.

The pinned ECCV20-STDN tree (12 source files) contains ZERO occurrences of '140', 'vertex', 'vertices', '3DMM', 'BFM', 'Basel', or any depth-rendering code. The ECCV20 release therefore does NOT supply the PhySTD geometry route.
The TPAMI 2022 paper contains NO supplementary-material section (a full-text search for 'supplementar' returns no match).

The TPAMI 2022 paper never names the Basel Face Model: a full-text search for 'BFM' and 'Basel Face Model' returns NO match. The BFM requirement reaches E04 only transitively, through the [61] Dense Face Alignment README.

bfm_asset.required_by: The [61] Dense Face Alignment README ('Setup: 1. Download the Basel Face Model (BFM)'), not by the PhySTD/TPAMI paper itself, which never names it.
bfm_asset.exact_version_note: Neither the PhySTD/TPAMI paper nor the DeFA README states WHICH BFM version. DeFA (ICCVW 2017) predates BFM-2017, and its README links the original BFM page, but the paper fixes nothing, so the version is NOT uniquely determined.
bfm_asset.expected_files_note: The DeFA README says only 'unzip the file into the root folder'. The pinned DeFA tree's removed binaries (Model_Para.mat, Model_info.mat, Model_Expression.mat, DeFA.mat) are model files, not the BFM distribution, and do not document the expected BFM filenames.
bfm_asset.why_automated_acquisition_not_permitted: The Basel Face Model is distributed only under a signed academic end-user licence: access requires a request form, an official academic e-mail address and a verifiable university affiliation. It cannot be fetched programmatically and must not be redistributed. M6A4 therefore did NOT download it, and the licence was NOT bypassed.

q140_vertex_set.published_text_tpami_2022: We select Q=140 vertices to cover the face region so that they can represent non-rigid deformation, due to pose and expression.
q140_vertex_set.published_text_section_4_1: We use the open-source face alignment [70] and 3DMM fitting [61] to crop the face and provide 140 landmarks.
searched_for_index_list_in: TPAMI 2022 published full text incl. all sections and reference list
q140_vertex_set.conclusion: Only the COUNT (140) and a qualitative rationale are published. No index list, table, appendix, supplementary file or author-released config/data file enumerating WHICH 140 vertices are selected was located. Reverse-engineering a 140-vertex set, reusing another paper's 140-point set, or substituting the FaceXFormer 68 landmarks are all PROHIBITED and were NOT done.

depth_rendering_procedure.published_text: We apply the dense face alignment [61] to estimate the 3D shape and render the depth ground truth M0.
depth_rendering_procedure.what_IS_specified: Only the NETWORK OUTPUT is specified: 'It outputs a face depth map M in R^{32x32}, where the depth values are normalized within [0,1]' (K=32).
depth_rendering_procedure.critical_distinction: M0 - the depth GROUND TRUTH - is an INPUT to the published training algorithm ('Algorithm 1: STDN+ Training Iteration. Input: ... ground truth depth map M0, preliminary mask P0'). The paper therefore treats M0 as pre-computed and never describes how it is produced.
unspecified_items: output scale and range of M0
depth_rendering_procedure.conclusion: The exact procedure for converting fitted 3DMM geometry into the 32x32 depth target M0 is not published in the arXiv version, the published TPAMI version, any supplementary material (there is none), or any released code. No step was inferred.
